svg.title: Zeppelin Hadoop Analytics Architecture
svg.desc: Left-to-right data flow from GCP Provisioned Cluster through Zeppelin Web Interface, Spark on Hadoop, Hive Metastore, wdi_csv_parquet Table, Zeppelin Notebook, to Notebook Results. GitHub Repository connects to the Zeppelin Notebook via a dotted line.
svg.text: Spark jobs are executed from Zeppelin on a GCP-provisioned Hadoop environment
using Hive-backed tables for GDP analysis.
Environment used to evaluate Spark on Zeppelin and compare it with Databricks
